name: medo-music
description: A refined local desktop music player
author: MedoMusic

scripts.check: node --check src/main.js && node --check src/preload.js && node --check src/renderer.js && node --check src/lyrics-window.js && node --check src/lyrics-timing.js && node --check src/lyrics-source-priority.js && node --check src/netease-eapi.js && node --check src/qq-music.js && node --check src/zpl.js && node --check src/media-file-response.js
scripts.test: npm run check && node tests/media-file-response.test.js && node tests/zpl.test.js && node tests/text-decoder.test.js && node tests/lyrics-timing.test.js && node tests/lyrics-source-priority.test.js && node tests/netease-eapi.test.js && node tests/qq-music.test.js && node tests/myfirefly-extension.test.js && node tests/tray-identity.test.js && node tests/removed-branding.test.js
scripts.dist: node scripts/clean-release.js && npm run test && npm run make-icon && electron-builder --win nsis && npm run install-local
